source:
@@U02438@@
As for me,
I regard myself
as your most honored ambassador,
and will love you as next of kin.
Where you are,
is abundance;
where I am,
each feels himself
gloriously blest.
And yet,
confused by this contrary life,
man often hesitates:
whether to follow you
and live a life of ease,
or me,
and never cease
to strive for the new.
I never act in secret.
Even with only a breath
I give myself away.
Farewell, now!
I know you wish me happiness,
but if ever you want me back,
just whisper, and I'll be here.

@@U02439@@
(Exit the BOY CHARIOTEER in the chariot.)

@@U02441@@
It is time to release
our treasures from captivity.
I strike the locks
with the herald’s staff,
and open it flies!
See there!
Molten gold,
red as blood,
bubbling up in brazen kettles
translation:
@@U02438@@
至于我，
我自视
作为您最尊敬的大使，
并会像近亲一样爱你。
你在哪里，
是丰富；
我在哪里，
每个人都感觉自己
光荣地祝福。
然而，
被这相反的生活所迷惑，
男人常常会犹豫：
是否关注你
并过着安逸的生活，
或者我，
并且永不停止
力求新。
我从来不秘密行事。
即使只有一口气
我放弃了自己。
再见，现在！
我知道你希望我幸福
但如果你想让我回来
只要低声说一声，我就会在这里。

@@U02439@@
（战车上的战童童子下。）

@@U02441@@
是时候释放了
我们被囚禁的宝藏。
我敲锁
与先驱报的工作人员一起，
打开它就飞了！
看到那里！
熔化的金子，
红如血，
在黄铜水壶中冒泡
